Teach the mechanism our reader should carry — a corridor is not a trade relationship, it is a direction. Infrastructure built to move goods can only move what a country has to sell, so a pass upgraded for connectivity turns into a highly efficient import channel and a customs-revenue line, which is fiscally welcome and structurally exactly backwards for a country with a chronic current-account problem. Establish the actual figures Wajid Ali gave and the year-on-year change, what the previous record was, what is imported and what is exported through Sust, how many days a year the pass is open (it closes for winter — that constraint is load-bearing and rarely stated), what share of total Pakistan-China trade crosses here against the sea route through Karachi and Gwadar, what the Central Asian transit component actually amounts to, and what CPEC documents projected for this crossing against what it delivers. Who bears the cost: Gilgit-Baltistan, which hosts the crossing, collects federal revenue from it, and holds no provincial status from which to claim a share. Pakistan is an OIC state and Dawn (PK) is the regional source, reporting from Gilgit on customs figures — attribute the numbers to Pakistan Customs. Note the feed's concept extraction mislabelled 'Pakistan Customs' as a cricket team; the entity is the revenue service.

stories.label: Tata Motors To Hike Car Prices By Up To Rs 25,000 From September 1
stories.summary: Tata Motors raises prices up to Rs 25,000 from 1 September across its whole passenger portfolio — and the detail worth leading with is that the increase covers electric vehicles as well as combustion ones. Everything in the EV cost narrative says battery packs get cheaper every year, so an EV price rise is a claim that some other input moved harder than cells fell. Teach the mechanism our reader should carry: an EV bill of materials is not mostly battery any more — it is rare-earth permanent magnets for the traction motor, power electronics, and imported drivetrain assemblies, all of which sit downstream of Chinese export controls and Indian import duty, so 'cheaper batteries' and 'cheaper electric cars' have quietly stopped being the same sentence. Establish exactly which models and variants rise and by how much, what Tata itself states as the reason and how that compares with what Maruti, Hyundai and Mahindra have announced for the same period, the September 1 effective date against India's festive buying season and what a pre-festive hike signals about expected demand, Tata's EV market share and what its EV volumes have done this year, and whether GST or customs-duty changes on components fall in the same window. Who bears the cost: Indian first-car buyers financing at the margin, for whom Rs 25,000 is roughly a month of median urban income. SELECTION NOTE FOR AUDIT: this was the only multi-source story in the entire 2026-08-23 04:00 feed — 1 cluster against a typical 8-13 — so the politics and economy multi-source floors could not be met this cycle from any candidate, weak or strong. The feed-side collapse, not editorial judgement, is what to investigate. Three Indian sources (NDTV, News18, MoneyControl), divergence 0.04, so there is no framing dispute to adjudicate — the sources agree and add little to each other; carry the component-cost analysis independently.

stories.label: Lebanese families demand ICC trial for Israeli criminals
stories.summary: At a memorial in the Lebanese National Theatre called 'Martyrs of the Word and Image', the families of journalists killed in Lebanon by Israeli strikes asked for the ICC rather than for a Lebanese court. Lead with the choice of forum, because it is the whole story: relatives of the dead have concluded that no domestic remedy exists, and they are right for a reason worth stating plainly — Lebanon is not a state party to the Rome Statute, Israel is not either, and the Security Council will not refer, so the venue the families are demanding is one that currently has no jurisdiction over their case. Teach the mechanism our reader should carry: the ICC's reach is built from ratifications and referrals, not from the gravity of the crime, so a killing can be squarely within the court's subject-matter competence and entirely outside its territorial competence at the same time. That gap is not an oversight; it is the design, and Lebanon's own non-accession is part of it. Establish who the journalists were — name them and their outlets — when and where each was killed, how many media workers have been killed in Lebanon since the escalation and how many in Gaza over the same period, what investigations by RSF, CPJ or the UN have concluded about whether the strikes were deliberate, what Israel has said about each incident, what legal routes actually remain (universal jurisdiction in third states, a Lebanese Article 12(3) declaration accepting ICC jurisdiction, the ICJ), and what the Lebanese government has done or declined to do. Who bears the cost: families holding a memorial in place of a trial. SOURCING: Mehr (IR) is Iranian state media and an interested party to this conflict — attribute its account of the ceremony and its characterisations explicitly to Mehr, anchor casualty figures and investigative conclusions on CPJ, RSF or UN reporting, and do not adopt the word 'criminals' from the headline. No Lebanese outlet carried this in the feed; flag that gap for feed-side audit.

stories.label: 'Barclays 5' Palestine activists will not be tried as terrorists
stories.summary: A judge has ruled that the damage five Palestine activists caused at a Barclays branch does not meet the threshold for terrorism sentencing. Lead with what the ruling concedes by existing: the question was live, which means the prosecution asked a British court to treat window-breaking at a bank as terrorism and got far enough for a judge to have to say no. Teach the mechanism our reader should carry — under the Terrorism Act 2000 a 'terrorist' act includes serious damage to property done to influence a government and advance a political cause, so the statutory definition already reaches ordinary protest damage on its face, and the only thing standing between a protester and a terrorism uplift is prosecutorial discretion plus a judge's reading of seriousness. That is a very thin barrier, and it moves: this ruling is a ceiling placed by one judge, not a rule, so the next case starts from the same statute. Establish who the five are and what they did at which branch and when, the exact charges and what sentencing regime now applies, the judge's stated reasoning and the precise legal test applied, why Barclays was targeted — the campaign's claim about its holdings in arms manufacturers supplying Israel, which should be stated as the activists' claim with whatever documentary support exists — what the CPS argued, and how this sits alongside the proscription of Palestine Action and the arrests that followed it. Who holds power: the prosecutors choosing which statute to charge under; who bears the cost: anyone weighing whether a protest carries a criminal record or a terrorism conviction. SOURCING: Declassified UK is advocacy-forward and must not supply the framing — this entry is selected only because the underlying fact is a court ruling on the public record. Verify the ruling, the court, the judge and the charges against the court listing or mainstream legal reporting before publication, attribute every characterisation to Declassified, and if the ruling cannot be independently confirmed, drop the story rather than soften it.

stories.label: One Nation MP concedes party's migration target 'not too different' from Labor's once rural workforce included
stories.summary: One Nation MP David Farley concedes that his party's migration target is 'not too different' from Labor's once you add the 100,000 rural workers it also wants on top of the 130,000 it calls the 'true' number. Lead with the arithmetic, because the arithmetic is the argument: an anti-immigration party's real number and the governing party's real number converge to roughly the same figure, and the entire distance between them turns out to be which migrants get counted. Teach the mechanism our reader should carry — migration politics almost everywhere runs on the gap between the headline figure and the composition beneath it. Agricultural and care work that citizens will not do at the offered wage has to be filled, so every restrictionist programme quietly carves out a visa class for it, calls that class something other than migration, and campaigns against the residue. The same structure sits under Gulf kafala reform debates, Britain's seasonal worker scheme and the US H-2A visa: the objection is not to the number, it is to permanence and to who becomes a citizen. Establish exactly what Farley said and in what forum, One Nation's stated net overseas migration target and how it is constructed, Labor's current NOM figure and forecast, what Australian agriculture's actual labour shortfall is and what the existing backpacker and Pacific Australia Labour Mobility schemes already supply, what rights and pathway to residency a rural worker visa would carry, and what Farley was previously 'counselled' over. Who bears the cost: the workers admitted as labour but not as future citizens. Australia is the first Oceania story in the corpus in days — the daily audit has flagged the region at zero repeatedly, and this fills it with substance rather than filler.

stories.label: China's Next Aircraft Carrier Is Taking Shape
stories.summary: China's fourth carrier is now visible enough in imagery to argue about, and the question that matters is whether it is nuclear-powered. Lead there rather than on the hull: conventional carriers are regional instruments because they are chained to oilers and to friendly ports, while a nuclear carrier is a global one, and the difference decides whether Chinese naval aviation is a Taiwan-and-South-China-Sea capability or an Indian Ocean and Gulf one. Teach the mechanism our reader should carry — the binding constraint on power projection is not the ship, it is the logistics tail. A conventionally powered carrier group burns fuel that must be replenished at sea from tankers that themselves need bases, which is precisely why every distant-water navy in history has needed a chain of coaling stations, and why Djibouti, Gwadar, Hambantota and the Ream facility are read the way they are. Nuclear propulsion removes the ship's own fuel from that chain but not its escorts' or its air wing's, so the upgrade buys reach without buying independence. Establish which yard, what the imagery actually shows and on what dates, the evidence for and against nuclear propulsion and who is making each claim, displacement and catapult type against Fujian and against a Ford-class, how many carriers each of China, the US and India will field this decade, and what China has actually said officially. Who this reaches: littoral states of the Arabian Sea and the Gulf — Pakistan, Oman, the UAE and Saudi Arabia all sit inside the radius this ship would open, and their naval planning is the downstream consequence our reader should weigh. Single-source satellite-imagery analysis from a specialist defence outlet — attribute every measurement to the imagery and date the images, mark nuclear propulsion as unconfirmed inference, not fact, and do not let 'could be' become 'is'. Keep this distinct from the AIM-424 entry in the same cycle: that one is a US missile programme, this is a Chinese hull.

stories.label: U.S. imposes new Cuba sanctions; Progressive wins California special election; Congo Ebola outbreak "growing exponentially"
stories.summary: WRITE ONLY THE EBOLA ITEM — the source is a daily bulletin and the other two items in its headline are separate stories that do not belong in this article. The news is that the Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak is described as growing exponentially. Lead with what 'exponentially' means operationally rather than emotionally: in an Ebola outbreak the growth rate is a direct readout of how many transmission chains are unobserved, because every case whose contacts are traced and monitored is a chain that stops, and exponential growth is the signature of chains nobody is watching. Teach the mechanism our reader should carry — Ebola is controlled by contact tracing and ring vaccination, not by treatment, so an outbreak's trajectory measures the surveillance system rather than the virus, and the virus itself has not changed. That is why the same pathogen produces 30 cases in Uganda and 3,000 in a conflict zone. Establish which province and which Ebola species, the case and death counts with their date and their source, the case-fatality rate, when the outbreak was declared, how many contacts are under follow-up against how many are estimated to exist, whether ERVEBO ring vaccination has started and how many doses are in country, how many health workers are infected — always the leading indicator of infection-control failure — what WHO's risk assessment says, and how the 2025-26 cuts to US global health funding and to WHO's emergencies budget have changed the response capacity that exists on the ground now versus in 2019. Who holds power: the donors who fund the surveillance layer; who bears the cost: Congolese families in districts where the tracing team never arrives. SOURCING: anchor every number on WHO African Region situation reports and the DRC health ministry, not on the bulletin — the bulletin is the pointer, not the evidence. Africa was 2 of 25 stories in yesterday's audit; this is the region's most consequential running story and it has not been covered.

stories.label: How changing diets are creating new markets for Africa's Indigenous crops
stories.summary: Gluten-free demand in wealthy markets is creating export value for African indigenous grains — fonio, teff, sorghum, millet — that agricultural policy spent decades treating as subsistence crops to be replaced. Lead with the reversal and name what caused it: the crops did not change and the agronomy did not change; a coeliac-driven consumer category in Europe and North America changed, and that is now setting the price of a Sahelian grain. Teach the mechanism our reader should carry — indigenous crops were displaced not because they yield less but because research, subsidy and extension services were built around wheat, maize and rice, so the yield gap is an artefact of where breeding money went for seventy years. Export demand can reverse that by funding the research, and it carries a specific hazard with it: once a subsistence grain acquires an export price, the households that grow it start selling the harvest and buying cheaper imported carbohydrate, which is the quinoa pattern, and it moves nutrition in the wrong direction while moving income in the right one. Establish which crops and which countries, actual export volumes and price movement rather than 'growing interest', the nutritional and agronomic case — fonio's 6-8 week cycle and drought tolerance against wheat's water demand is the fact that matters for the Sahel under warming — what breeding or processing investment has followed, who captures the margin between the farmgate and the European shelf, and what the evidence from the Andean quinoa experience actually shows about local consumption after an export boom. Who bears the cost or gains: smallholder women farmers, who hold most indigenous-crop cultivation and least of the export chain. Global Voices (NL) single-source. Fills the Africa gap the daily audit has flagged at 2 of 25.

stories.label: Exploring the association between environmental exposure to phthalates and bisphenol A and changes in reproductive hormones in women: a cross-sectional study
stories.summary: A cross-sectional study links measured body burdens of phthalates and bisphenol A to shifts in women's reproductive hormone levels. Lead with the exposure route rather than the endocrinology, because the route is what makes this a policy story: these are plasticisers and can linings, so the dose is set by food packaging, water storage and cosmetics, which means exposure is not a behaviour anyone chooses but a property of the supply chain a person can afford. Teach the mechanism our reader should carry — endocrine disruptors work by fitting a receptor well enough to signal, so their effects do not follow the usual dose-response rule that more is worse; low doses can act where high doses do not, which is exactly why the toxicology thresholds most regulators still use were built for the wrong kind of molecule. Be rigorous about what this study can and cannot support: a cross-sectional design measures exposure and hormones at the same moment, so it establishes association and cannot establish direction or causation, and the article must say so in its own voice rather than in a caveat at the end. Establish the cohort size, country and how participants were selected, which metabolites were assayed and in what medium, which hormones moved and by how much with confidence intervals, whether the effect survives adjustment for BMI, age and cycle phase, and what prior longitudinal work has found. Then the part that reaches our reader: regulatory divergence is the real finding — the EU restricts several of these compounds under REACH while much of Asia, Africa and the Gulf does not, so the same product sold in two markets carries different chemistry, and plastic water storage in hot climates raises leaching well above the conditions the safety limits were set under. This is an early-access accepted manuscript; say so and give the DOI.

stories.label: Comparative performance and temporal variability of large language models on orthodontic questions from a national dental specialty examination
stories.summary: Researchers ran several large language models against a national dental specialty examination and measured not only how well each scored but how much the same model's answers moved over time. Lead with the temporal variability, because that is the finding everyone else will bury under the leaderboard: the same model, given the same exam questions on two dates, does not give the same answers — and a system whose output drifts under a fixed input has no stable accuracy figure to quote. Teach the mechanism our reader should carry: a hosted model is a moving target. Providers retrain, quantise, re-route and swap system prompts behind an unchanged API name, so a hospital that validated a tool at 78% and deployed it has validated a version that no longer exists, and there is no version pin, no changelog and no regression suite in the way a medical device would require one. That is the actual regulatory gap in clinical AI, and it is invisible to every benchmark published as a single number. Establish which models were tested and at which dates, the exam and how many questions, the score for each model against the human pass mark, the magnitude of the drift between test rounds and whether it went up or down, whether the authors controlled temperature and sampling — this is essential, because drift from sampling randomness is a different claim from drift from a changed model, and the article must distinguish them — and what the authors recommend. Then the stakes: medical licensing exams are the most common way AI clinical competence is claimed to regulators and to the public, and this result says the claim expires. Relevant well beyond dentistry — Gulf and Southeast Asian health systems procuring diagnostic AI are buying against exactly these benchmarks. Early-access accepted manuscript; say so, give the DOI, and note it is exam performance, not patient outcomes.

stories.label: AIM-424 "Malice" Very Long-Range Air-To-Air Missile Emerges From The Shadows
stories.summary: The US Navy has acknowledged an extreme-range air-to-air missile, the AIM-424 'Malice', intended for the Super Hornet, the F-35C and the future F/A-XX. Lead with what a very-long-range missile is actually for, because it is not shooting down fighters: at these ranges the targets are the tankers, the airborne early warning aircraft and the jammers that a strike package cannot function without, and killing those is how you push an entire air force back beyond its own combat radius without ever engaging its fighters. Teach the mechanism our reader should carry — long-range air combat is a sensing problem, not a propulsion one. A missile can fly 300km, but something must see and keep seeing the target for the minutes it takes to arrive, which means the shot depends on a datalink chain running through satellites, other aircraft and ships. Every one of those links is jammable, and that is precisely why counter-space and electronic warfare have become air-superiority weapons: the missile's real range is the range of the network that guides it. Establish what the Navy has actually disclosed and when, the claimed range class against AIM-174B, AIM-260 and China's PL-17, which aircraft carry how many and what that does to a carrier's magazine depth, unit cost against the aircraft it is meant to kill, and the programme timeline. Then the consequence that reaches our reader: as these weapons proliferate, the airborne tanker and AEW fleets that every regional air force depends on — including Gulf states operating F-15s, F-16s and Rafales with a handful of irreplaceable support aircraft — become the decisive vulnerability, and a country can lose air superiority having lost no fighters at all. Single-source specialist defence reporting: attribute capability figures to the Navy or to the outlet's analysis and mark the range claims as estimates. Distinct from the China carrier entry this cycle — different programme, different country, do not merge.

stories.label: BitMart weighs partial restart, creditor payouts weeks after announcing shutdown
stories.summary: Four weeks after telling users it was closing, BitMart is considering restarting parts of its business while paying creditors — and the fact that it can simply decide this is the story. Lead there: a bank that announces it is shutting does not get to reopen on its own timetable, because a resolution authority takes the decision out of its hands the moment it becomes insolvent. BitMart has no such authority over it, so 'shutdown' and 'restart' are both management choices, and the customers whose assets sit inside are creditors of a firm that is still writing its own procedure. Teach the mechanism our reader should carry — the whole of depositor protection is the separation of the failing firm's interests from the decision about the failing firm. Deposit insurance, bank resolution and even ordinary bankruptcy exist to install an administrator with duties to creditors, and an offshore exchange is engineered to sit outside every one of those, which is why 'not your keys, not your coins' is a legal statement and not a slogan. Establish exactly what BitMart said on 26 July and what it is saying now, what user assets are frozen and at what value, which jurisdiction it is incorporated and licensed in and what insolvency regime would apply there if any, what role White & Case is playing and for whom, whether withdrawals are open, what a 'phased restart' means for someone who filed a claim, and how this compares with the FTX and Celsius estates where a court did appoint an administrator. Who holds power: the exchange's own management, still; who bears the cost: retail users outside the US and EU, for whom offshore exchanges are often the only access to the asset class. CoinDesk (US) single-source and close to the industry it covers — attribute the restructuring plans to the company and to unnamed sources as the outlet does, and do not report a considered restart as a decided one.
